limitations: One paired negative-admission run on two separate GitHub-hosted workers; not a distribution or percentile estimate.
The under-test canonical checker failed intentionally with exit 1 in both arms. Proof success attests the expected refusal, not application qualification.
The primary timing begins after the original workflow inventory boundary and excludes checkout, LFS, parser preparation, probes and final restoration. Full job timings are separately reported.
Positive and negative controls run before timing in both arms, warming filesystem reads. No compiler cache is restored; before runs the actual original expensive commands.
Hosted CPU and queue variability affects full-job comparison; API job and step times have one-second resolution, command timings use monotonic nanoseconds.
The exact candidate passed its complete Documentation job separately. Its total duration is not a matched causal green-run speed comparison.
No claim of 30% faster routine CI or lower successful Native/GDExtension critical path; unchanged successful-run test inventory still executes.
measurement_scope: Actual paired negative admission comparison; same proof commit, identical canonical command definitions, changed order only.
